Never gonna play laggy FPS asz games with bad looking graphics even with maxed out settings again!
Honestly pretty fun. Don't get me wrong, the comparisons to L4D are undeniable but I've still had a blast with this game over time and loved watching the project evolve.

Disappointing content...
Bugs that were present during Early Access...
Lack of exposition and replayability...
Workshop support... well, that's cool, but I feel like the developers are expecting the community to create additional content for this game...
I'd like to recommend it, it's fun, but it's still lacking in many areas......
Buy only on sale, with friends we finished it in three and a half hours on medium difficulty

No reason to play this over the Left 4 Dead games

-Guns feel like they have no impact
-Gameplay is pretty boring and unsatisfying
-Characters are annoying

You can usually buy the Left 4 Dead games at a massive fraction of the cost of this game with much more enjoyable gameplay and plenty of content
This game makes you appreciate back 4 blood, which is really saying something.

Archaic, unpolished and dead on arrival.

I have played Half-Life mods that have had better production value than this sorry excuse of a Left4Dead clone. Decades ago!

This is just another shinning example of a glaringly mismanaged project that's been dumped on Early Access by an obviously, highly out of touch studio who are under the delusion that Steam's Early Access is an alternative for Kickstarter. It may be out of Early Access but it most certainly is not a finished product. Not even close to it.

The gunplay's still static and stale. They have received complaints about this since it arrived on Early Access and have done absolutely nothing to rectify it. It lacks any kind of visual or audible feedback. There's no "oomph" to the gunplay. It's anything but visceral. Why even bother making a shooter then if you can't even get the fundamentals right? It feels like you're using nerf guns when you're shooting at the masses of paper mache dolls that just either slump over or ragdoll all over the many corridors that make up the "level design" of this thing. 

Did i mention that the game is dead?

https://steamdb.info/app/1120480/charts/

https://steamcharts.com/app/1120480

I am in California. I was only able to matchmake with players when Intel handed out a few thousand copies for free over a year ago. That lasted a couple of days. Nothing but bot matches before and ever since then. Crossplay may as well not exist.

That, however, does not stop the sordid individuals behind this mess from lying about the state of this waste of money. Not only that. They're banning people for merely discussing the lack of a playerbase and removing any discussions on it. That's how pitiful they are.

There's so many solid Left4Dead clones out there from which you can choose from. Games that are actually worth your time and money. This sure ain't one of them.
